instruction.text: Listen to Derek and Sylvie talking about what to play in PE.

atoms.b: Volleyball is the best game ever. Let’s play volleyball!
Not true! Obviously basketball is the better game!
Are you kidding? I’m sure everyone will agree with me and want to play volleyball.
If you’re so sure, let’s have a vote!

instruction.text: Voting is a fair way to make a choice as a group. Find the raised hands to watch Derek and Sylvie have a vote.

atoms.text: “I think we should play volleyball today!”
“I think we should play basketball instead.”
“Raise your hand if you want to play volleyball!”

instruction.text: How many people are voting to play volleyball?

hint.text: Count the children who have raised their hands to find out the answer.

atoms.text: “Raise your hand if you want to play basketball!”

instruction.text: How many people are voting to play basketball?

hint.text: Count the children who have raised their hands to find out the answer.

feedback.finish: More people voted for basketball than for volleyball, so the children are going to play basketball.

instruction.text: Sort the three steps of voting, with the first at the top.

hint.text: Select each image to hear what is happening.

atoms.sound: First, someone explains the choices there are.
During the second step, everyone makes a choice and votes.
Finally, the votes are counted, and a winning option is found.

instruction.sound: ssml: Spell the word. <break time='500ms'/> Vote.
